Name: Train Station (Iterum)
Author: mouahrara
Description:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/main.jpg[/img]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/scrolls/01.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29911]Transport Framework[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]This mod doesn't do anything on its own; you need to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29911]Transport Framework[/url] content packs adding stations to the [font=Courier New][color=#cccccc]Train[/color][/font] network separately.[/b][/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/scrolls/02.png[/img]

[size=3]To use this mod, go to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Railroad]railroad[/url] and interact with the ticket machine to buy a ticket. If it says "There are no destinations available at the moment." make sure you've installed a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29911]Transport Framework[/url] content pack that adds a station to the [font=Courier New][color=#cccccc]Train[/color][/font] network and that its unlock conditions are satisfied.[/size]

[size=3]See [url=https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0b1707e-eee0-49f0-9e7b-ac2c00235818]demo[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/scrolls/03.png[/img]

[size=3]The Train Station (Iterum) mod allows you to add additional stations to the railway transport network, You can do this by creating a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29911]Transport Framework[/url] content pack that adds a station to the [font=Courier New][color=#cccccc]Train[/color][/font] network. Please refer to the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/TransportFramework/wiki]mod author documentation[/url] for more information about the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29911]Transport Framework[/url] mod.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/scrolls/04.png[/img]

[size=3]English and French translations are included in the base mod, and contributions are welcome. To contribute, please submit a pull request on the [url=https://github.com/mouahrara/TrainStation/pulls]GitHub repository[/url].[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/scrolls/05.png[/img]

[size=3]Train Station is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ on Linux/Mac/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/size]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/mouahrara/TrainStation/images/scrolls/06.png[/img]

[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/190812873?tab=user+files]My other mods[/url][/size]
[/list]
[size=2][i]Endorse and vote for this mod if you like it! Thank you for your support![/i][/size]
